proposed_local_extraction: Read the existing source capture manifest; verify its UUID/source manifest hash and original consecutive frame metadata. Preview whether168..207 contains approach/motion/settle before committing to that interval.

Read the original owned input/raw/selected/encoded payloads for the fixed strip. Verify full source payload hashes first. Preserve original words and source-relative filenames; do not recalculate radiance, motion, normal or alpha.

Reuse the existing trace copy and export contract; export typed arrays and full per-frame metadata, retaining role aliases. Include original motion only if it was actually observed; missing data must remain null/absent with a reason.
Compute original-file, crop-byte, array and archive SHA256. Use allow_pickle=False-compatible arrays and no private machine paths.

If missing observations are not in the original capture, request one new bounded unlooped capture under GPU_REQUEST.json. Do not guess missing tensors from the seven-frame crop or patch its baseline files.

payload.compression: Lossless NPZ/ZIP permitted; cap is on uncompressed useful payload, not a promise about compression ratio.
payload.alias_policy: Do not duplicate aliased raw/selected/normal resources; retain explicit alias metadata and hashes.
payload.row_pitch_policy: Export rows tightly packed after fence-protected mapping. Record original resource row pitch/stride separately; padding is not requested.
payload.original_gpu_row_pitch_reason: Must be taken from each actual CopyFootprintMetadata; not inferred from packed export width.
payload.no_extra_payload: Do not upload full full-resolution renders, DLLs, replay caches, opaque provider histories or unrelated captures.

final_clip_separate.stage: Actual final title/upscaler output after Consumer, distinct from encoded commit.
final_clip_separate.format: Lossless same-crop RGB frame sequence with original timestamps preferred; alternatively same-crop lossless video plus exact frame-index mapping.
final_clip_separate.unknown_fields_instruction: Read and report actual output format/transfer, exposure, tone-map settings and frame timing. Preserve each panel aspect/exposure; no independently normalized frames.
final_clip_separate.why: H5 and final apparent shape cannot be resolved from pre-remod/encoded tensors. If final frames cannot be exactly keyed, retain the mismatch as uncertainty.
